evidence.claim: Flagged txn 3553342 is $30.91, below the card's 180-day mean of $82.40 (amount_z -0.39, 0.38x mean), far below the card max of $2,681.01.
Region 494 is not new for this card: 21 prior transactions in history, and the card was used there on 2016-12-12 as well as 2016-12-18; new_region_for_card = false.
Channel and product match the dominant baseline: in_person 849/910 and product W 849/910 (93.3% share each); the flagged txn is in_person / W.

Normal home activity continued through the window (13 home-region transactions within 48h) across 22 transactions in many familiar regions (264, 325, 330, 272, 433, 204), so there is no clone signature of paused home activity.
No known-pattern sequence: card_testing_runs empty, just_under_500_runs empty, only 1 online transaction in the episode ($5.92, 3545223), no device or proxy on the flagged authorization.

Prior closed case CC-0003 on this exact card was a 0.91-scored $442.92 alert cleared after the cardholder confirmed travel; the earlier confirmed fraud CC-2370 was online CNP activity, a channel almost absent here.
Region 494's newcomer cluster shows 9 newcomer cards in 7 days with a 0.56 fraud-history rate, but C05876-K2 is not a newcomer (21 historical transactions there), so the cluster does not apply to it.

Residual watch item: the single online $5.92 txn 3545223 used the rare profile 'unknown | Android | chrome 66.0 | 1280x720' (12 cards all-time, 8 in window), a profile also seen on C00750-K2 and C01104-K2 which carry confirmed fraud cases; the flagged in-person charge has no device link.
Semantic memory shows repeated precedents where mid-to-high model scores on modest amounts in a billing region were cleared after cardholder confirmation (CC-0994, CC-0042, CC-4974).
Policy §6 permits stopping at or below 0.15 fraud probability with at least two independent supporting pieces of evidence.

case.summary: Alert HHG-012 was raised purely by a 0.55 model score on a $30.91 in-person purchase in region 494. Everything structural contradicts fraud: the region has 21 prior transactions on this card (last used six days earlier), the amount is 0.38x the card's mean, the channel/product match 93% of a 910-transaction baseline, and the cardholder's dense normal activity continued across familiar regions before and after. No card-testing run, no threshold-skimming run, no new device and only one small online transaction in the whole window. A prior alert on this same card (CC-0003) scored 0.91 and was cleared on cardholder confirmation. One secondary observation: the lone online $5.92 authorization 3545223 used the rare device profile 'unknown | Android | chrome 66.0 | 1280x720' (12 cards all-time), shared with cards carrying confirmed fraud — not enough to taint the flagged charge, but worth passive monitoring of that profile.
